cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with FGR and healthy controls.
finding: FGR subjects exhibited enriched bacterial OTUs of the genus Bacteroides in the maternal gut, and depleted OTUs of the order Enterobacterales and genus Pseudomonas in the amniotic fluid and genus Stenotrophomonas in the fetal gut, which significantly correlated with neonatal weight and fetal ultrasonographic indexes.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy/at birth for sample collection.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight was measured and correlated with microbiota alterations.
